list.title: Templates
list.name: Name
list.emptyHint: Write it once. Send it whenever.
list.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. Broadcasts that started from it keep their copy.
list.htmlChipHint: Created as HTML; opens in code mode

html.banner: Created as HTML. The block editor can't edit this layout faithfully, so it opens in code mode.
html.convertBody: The layout will be flattened into the block editor's model: tables, inline CSS and anything the blocks can't express are lost. The stored HTML only changes when you save.

editor.nameHint: Internal label. Recipients never see it.
editor.htmlSourceHint: The HTML Posta sends. Merge tags are filled in for each recipient.
editor.textSourceHint: The plain-text version, sent beside the HTML. Merge tags are filled in for each recipient.
editor.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text instead.
editor.stateError: Couldn't save. Your changes are kept on this device.
editor.hiddenBySupportView: Template content is hidden in support view.

publish.unchanged: Version {version} is already the latest. Nothing changed.

versions.title: Versions and tags
versions.intro: Publishing freezes the saved draft as the next version. A send that names this template uses the newest version, or the one a tag points at.
versions.empty: Nothing is published yet. Publish the template to make version 1.
versions.deleteTagged: Move or remove its tags first.
versions.tagHint: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. A tag that already exists moves to this version.
versions.tagInvalid: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
versions.tagDigits: A tag can't be only digits, since those are version numbers.
versions.loadBody: The editor has unsaved changes, and loading this version replaces them. Nothing is saved until you save.
versions.loaded: Version {version} is in the editor. Save to make it the draft.

previewText.label: Preview text
previewText.hintEmpty: Shown after the subject in most inboxes. Without it, they show the email's opening line.
previewText.hintFits: Shown after the subject in most inboxes.
previewText.hintLong: Most inboxes cut it off after about {max} characters.
previewText.none: No preview text. Inboxes show the email's opening line instead.

picker.label: Start from a template
picker.hint: Copies its content here. Later template edits change nothing.
picker.replaceBody: Applying this template overwrites the current body, subject and preview text.

preflight.label: Checks
preflight.codeNote: Links and images are only checked in templates built with blocks.

issue.link-empty: {node, select, button {This button has no link. Add a web address, or remove the button.} linkCard {This link card has no link. Add a web address, or remove the card.} other {This link has no web address. Add one, or remove the link.}}
issue.link-invalid: {node, select, button {This button's link} linkCard {This card's link} image {This image's link} other {This link}} isn't a full web address. Start it with https://, or use mailto: or tel:.
issue.link-insecure: {node, select, button {This button's link} linkCard {This card's link} image {This image's link} other {This link}} uses http://. Switch to https:// so it opens without a browser warning.
issue.image-src-missing: {node, select, logo {This logo} inlineImage {This inline image} other {This image}} has no source. Paste an image address, or remove it.
issue.image-src-invalid: {node, select, logo {This logo} inlineImage {This inline image} other {This image}} can't load in an inbox from that address. Use a full web address starting with https://.
issue.image-alt-missing: {node, select, logo {This logo} inlineImage {This inline image} other {This image}} has no alt text. Add a short description so screen readers can describe it.
issue.merge-field-unknown: {name} isn't a built-in variable or a contact property, so it will send blank. Pick a variable from the list, or add the property first.
issue.merge-field-unknown-suggest: {name} isn't a variable here, so it will send blank. Did you mean {suggestion}?
issue.merge-field-no-fallback: {name} has no default, so contacts without it get a blank. Add a default to the variable.
issue.merge-field-malformed: A merge field here isn't written correctly, so it would send as broken text. Write it like {example}.
issue.merge-field-braces: Two braces aren't a merge field and send as typed. Use three, like {example}.
issue.subject-empty: No subject. Whatever sends this template needs to bring its own.
issue.preview-text-empty: No preview text. Inboxes will show the email's first line instead.
issue.preview-text-long: The preview text is {length} characters; most inboxes show about {shown}. Shorten it so it isn't cut off.
issue.theme-contrast-text: Text is hard to read on the email background ({ratio, number, ::.0}:1). Aim for 4.5:1 or more.
issue.theme-contrast-heading: Headings are hard to read on the email background ({ratio, number, ::.0}:1). Aim for 4.5:1 or more.
issue.theme-contrast-link: Links are hard to read on the email background ({ratio, number, ::.0}:1). Aim for 4.5:1 or more.
issue.theme-contrast-button: Button text is hard to read on the button ({ratio, number, ::.0}:1). Aim for 4.5:1 or more.
issue.size-near: This email is {size} KB, close to the {limit} KB where Gmail cuts messages off. Trim some content before it grows.
issue.size-over: This email is {size} KB. Gmail cuts messages off after about {limit} KB and hides the rest. Trim images, text or styling.

theme.title: Email theme
theme.hint: How the email looks to the people who get it. The editor stays in your dashboard theme.
theme.hexInvalid: Use a hex colour, such as #6538d6.

issues.title: Hard to read
issues.text: Text on the email background is {ratio}:1. Aim for 4.5:1 or more.
issues.heading: Headings on the email background are {ratio}:1. Aim for 4.5:1 or more.
issues.link: Links on the email background are {ratio}:1. Aim for 4.5:1 or more.
issues.button: Button text on the button is {ratio}:1. Aim for 4.5:1 or more.

picker.hint: Pick a starting point and change anything. Nothing is saved until you save.
picker.blankHint: An empty email, for when you know what you want to write.

starters.placeholderNote: This starter links to example.com. Replace those links before you send.

welcome.name: Welcome email
welcome.description: A short hello for new sign-ups, with one clear next step.
welcome.subject: Welcome, [FIRST_NAME|there]
welcome.previewText: Here is how to get started, and where to find help.
welcome.heading: Welcome aboard
welcome.intro: Thanks for signing up. Your account is ready, and these three steps will get you going.
welcome.step2: Invite the people you work with.
welcome.help: Questions? Reply to this email and a person will answer.

password-reset.name: Password reset
password-reset.description: A reset link that expires, and a line for anyone who did not ask.
password-reset.subject: Reset your password
password-reset.previewText: Use this link to choose a new password. It works for the next hour.
password-reset.heading: Reset your password
password-reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for [EMAIL|your account]. Choose a new one with the button below.
password-reset.expiry: This link works for one hour. After that, you can ask for a new one.
password-reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password will not change.

receipt.name: Receipt
receipt.description: A payment confirmation with the order, the amount and a link to the details.
receipt.subject: Your receipt
receipt.previewText: Thanks for your order. Here is a summary of what you paid for.
receipt.heading: Thanks for your order
receipt.intro: We have received your payment. This is a summary for your records.
receipt.help: If anything looks wrong, reply to this email and we will sort it out.

product-update.name: Product update
product-update.description: Two things that changed, each with a short note, and a link to the rest.
product-update.subject: What is new this month
product-update.previewText: Two changes we think you will like, and a link to everything else.
product-update.heading: What is new
product-update.intro: Here is what we shipped since our last update.
product-update.firstBody: Pages now load in about half the time. There is nothing to change on your side.
product-update.secondBody: Write now, send later. Pick a date and a time, and we take care of the rest.
product-update.footer: You are getting this because you signed up for updates.

newsletter.name: Newsletter
newsletter.description: A feature story, a pull quote and a short list of reading.
newsletter.subject: This month, in short
newsletter.previewText: One story worth your time, and three links we think you will want to read.
newsletter.heading: This month, in short
newsletter.intro: A quick round-up of what we have been working on and reading.
newsletter.featureBody: Tell the story in a few short paragraphs. Start with what changed for the reader, explain how, and end with one clear next step.
newsletter.quote: A short line from a customer or a teammate sits well here.
newsletter.link3: A look at our new pricing
newsletter.signoff: Until next time, and thanks for reading.
newsletter.footer: You are getting this because you subscribed.
